_description: Full lifecycle: employment_savings accumulate into Traditional (30k/yr) and Roth (20k/yr) for 10 years, then retirement spending draws from Traditional first (waterfall order, no taxable account).
_rationale: Ages 55-64: two employment_savings events (after_tax) route 30k/yr to trad-1 and 20k/yr to roth-1 via accountId. 0% return, 0% inflation. After 10 years: trad=300k, roth=200k, total=500k. Ages 65-70: 15k/yr spending drawn from Traditional (below the 16,100+2,050=18,150 deduction for age 65+), so tax=0 and W=15k exactly. Roth stays untouched. After 6 retirement years: trad=300k-6*15k=210k, roth=200k, total=410k. Never depletes: probability=100%.
name: Savings Then Drawdown
